notes: Colour: the reference's four deep colours become the palette's colours that read 4.5:1 on the ground (accent, extras, ink). A client with one such colour (law1: only the navy ink) gets every card, tile and rule in that one colour; its light accent (yellow) becomes the ground of the price band, the quote band and the first tile, with dark words.
Not for restaurants (no menu) and not for software (no screens).
A client with fewer than about 8 priced rows and few people gives a page of some 6 000 px, close to the reference; school1's is 15 000.
needs (as written): place.address or locations, and contact — they are the foot
drops (as written): hero.text2 when longer than 60 characters (school1: a 220-character second paragraph)
drops (as written): foot.text when the client has place.address or locations (the same facts stand in the foot columns)
drops (as written): media.video (the reference opens on a film; the template shows a still photograph)
drops (as written): place.spaces[].img and steps[].img as such (a step's picture is used only if it is at least 900 wide; rooms come from the strip, chosen by role)
drops (as written): team group titles (people of all groups stand in one list)

drops (as written): photographs beyond the slots: of school1's 18, 10 are shown (3 wide, 1 group, 6 rooms in the strip) and the other 8 small ones are not; of law1's 12, all 12 (plus its 3 award pictures)
motif (as written): the client's own photographs (no made pictures)
